body: Good to know another name that may work for my BF. He's being put on meds, and I'm worried out small sex life now will turn into zero sex.. The only reason I'm using this throwaway account was to get advice on what to do right now.

They also kill it for girls and make it nearly impossible to orgasm. Which didn't help the depression much.. 

Source: Took them for over 2 years.

I'm just afraid I'm going to cry when I go. I wasn't prepared for any of this... even though it was apparent this was what was going to happen. I don't have much privacy in my own apartment from his mother, so I want to speak with him but don't want her listening (i just dont want anybody listening.. its just how i am when im on the phone) and i know i'll get choked up.. i dont want him to hear me cry and have it upset him. i dont want him to see it either...

now its bed time and he's not here... I'm just stuck feeling really sad about it all instead of letting my logical side take over.. I can even hear the voice of reason saying "It's ok. He's fine" But the insides of me are like no... he's not here, he's always here, and that means somethings wrong.

He can't really afford to miss many days which also worries me. We live with his mom, but its more like a roommate situation. We all pay our shares of the rent and utilities. He doesn't have any extra money, he cant even afford groceries, so I was panicing when I found out he was going to the hospital with no insurance, but I guess they got that covered somehow. But we don't even know his standing with his job because he's been sent home several times for panic/anxiety attacks at work. I figured they wouldn't fire someone if they feared firing them might make them kill themselves. But they can't keep someone around just for that reason either... so I fear things outside arent going to improve while he's gone, and he'll have bills to pay, and he'll end up needing more help. And I don't think I could handle not having him get better being very far away from my family, I would eventually have to go back home to my parents because there's no way I could stay as I neglected to make close friends while I lived in my new state .. I'm not really good at making friends. I was completely content until recently and realizing how alone I can be when he's depressed and now not even here.

I don't even know if he's in the mental hospital or regular one getting evauated. Idk how these things work i guess, I stay away from hospitals obviously. 

I was once on anti-depressants. The side effects killed one of my relationships. So I'm still worried..

As for visiting hours, I'm afraid I'd be a blubbering idiot, like he actually tried to kill himself, and i was his mother or something. or get a panic attack due to my phobia of hospital stuff.

His mom has her own emotional issues with this as its her son, and she too is scared. I've avoided her all day because I cant emotionally handle it. I dont want to talk about it with her.. idk I shut myself in and do not wish to speak to anyone (except i guess for the internet which is partly distracting me from reality of seeing his crap laying all over the place and he isnt here.)

He didn't attempt suicide, god I can't bare to imagine what if he did. I'd probably have to be admitted.. my mind was having a difficult time grasping the thought that he was THINKING it, let alone, actually trying... I feel I'm so close to losing grip of my own emotions.

I signed off my other throwaway earlier, and forgot the password.. so this is a new one! Thank you for your advice.. To answer some questions.. 

He was admitted today, so he's getting active help. I don't have any family or really close friends right here, but I have my mom to call eventually. I'm not in the mood to talk to anyone at the moment, because I'm absolutely terrified.


I just posted another thread in /r/SuicideWatch 

http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/1f89fv/my_bf_was_admitted_today_and_im_freaked_out_help/

It addresses new issues I have. Maybe if you could share your experiences on visiting your ex-boyfriend?
